summary: Testing completed for Feature 1 (ABHA/NDHM Integration) and Feature 2 (Vernacular Language Support). All 15 backend API tests passed. Frontend testing confirmed ABHA page loads correctly with info banner, Create button, and link input. ABHA Create flow works end-to-end (method selection → details → OTP → success). Settings page shows all 6 languages (English, Hindi, Marathi, Gujarati, Tamil, Telugu) and language switching works. Regression tests for Home and DiaGyn pages passed.
critical_code_review_comments: ABHA APIs are in DEMO MODE - OTP is always 123456, ABHA numbers are randomly generated. In production, these would call ABDM sandbox APIs.
LanguageContext correctly stores preference in localStorage under 'nevika_language'
All 6 languages have 100+ translation keys each
ABHA page has proper data-testid attributes for testing
seed_data_creation: ABHA test records created during testing (prefixed with TEST_)
context_for_next_testing_agent: ABHA/NDHM and Language features fully tested. ABHA APIs work in demo mode with OTP 123456. Language selector shows 6 languages and switching works correctly. All regression tests pass.

features_tested.feature: ABHA page (/abha) loads correctly with info banner, Create button, and link input
features_tested.details: Page loads with 'What is ABHA?' info banner, 'Create New ABHA' button, and ABHA number link input field

features_tested.feature: ABHA Create flow: Click 'Create New ABHA' → Choose method (Aadhaar/Mobile) → Enter details → Send OTP → Verify with 123456 → ABHA card shown
features_tested.details: Full flow works - method selection shows Aadhaar and Mobile options, details entry works, OTP step shows demo hint (123456), verification creates ABHA and shows success toast

features_tested.feature: ABHA API: POST /api/abha/create/init with mobile method works
features_tested.details: Returns transaction_id, message, demo_mode=true. Validates 10-digit mobile number.

features_tested.feature: ABHA API: POST /api/abha/create/verify with OTP 123456 creates ABHA
features_tested.details: Returns abha_number (XX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX format), abha_address, name, status=active

features_tested.feature: ABHA API: POST /api/abha/link links ABHA to phone
features_tested.details: Successfully links ABHA number to phone number

features_tested.feature: ABHA API: GET /api/abha/profile/{phone} returns linked profile
features_tested.details: Returns linked=true with abha_number, abha_address, name for linked phones; linked=false for non-linked

features_tested.feature: Language selector on Settings page (/settings) shows 6 languages: English, Hindi, Marathi, Gujarati, Tamil, Telugu
features_tested.details: All 6 languages visible with native names: English, हिंदी, मराठी, ગુજરાતી, தமிழ், తెలుగు

features_tested.feature: Language switching works: switch to Hindi and verify translated text appears
features_tested.details: Switching to Hindi shows 'भाषा' in header, checkmark on Hindi option

features_tested.feature: Home page (/) still loads correctly (regression check)
features_tested.details: Nevika Cura branding visible, DiaGyn/Mango/Orange links present

features_tested.feature: DiaGyn page (/diagyn) still loads correctly (regression check)
features_tested.details: DiaGyn Healthcare branding visible, Book now button present, doctor content visible
